Name: Dubli Boot 500 gm
LongDescription: Dubli Boot, also known as Horse Gram (Macrotyloma uniflorum), is a small, dark brown legume commonly used in South Asian and Ayurvedic cuisines. Known for its high nutritional content, this legume is a rich source of protein, fiber, and essential minerals.
